behavior: Per-task native command grants: repeatable build-only --allow-command, validated and compiled to per-call permissions.allow command() rules, listed in the builder prompt

claims.claim: Up to 16 strings, 1 to 512 characters, closed character set, no leading/trailing space, no repeats
Limits and checks: 16 strings, 512 characters, duplicates and edge spaces rejected
Flag without --build, or a bad list, is a usage error before agy starts
Strings come only from the command line, repeatable
Strings become --settings {permissions:{allow:[command(<s>)]}} in order given; no --settings without the flag; no deny rule added
A non-agy family with --build is a usage error
Prompt lists the strings verbatim, says run exactly as written; other commands not granted or refused by the wrapper
In live probes a rule let through the command written in it; exact vs prefix matching unverified
Settings shape used in the probes
agy runs --mode accept-edits with a finite print timeout and stream-json; no --sandbox or skip-permissions on the build path
--json carries no receipt field for grants
--build is opt-in, normal Antigravity permissions, points to docs/neon-builder.md

behavior: Sticky native refusal evidence across every result event and merged step/subagent updates; exit 4 with no answer or build; bounded sanitized denied and notes (64) for native builds; denial plus model mismatch exits 4, mismatch alone 2

claims.claim: Refusal kinds: DENIED, or ERROR on deny rule / approval / consent / user denied / EACCES etc.; other errors such as not found do not fail
Failed state and error message in separate updates count together; a refusal is never cleared by later updates
denied_actions on any result event counts as a refusal
Subagent refusals counted only when the stream carries them
denied and notes capped at 64 with a count of the rest, for native builds
denied entries name the tool and refusal kind, never agy's message
Build does not read subagent transcripts; notes say a subagent was started
Refusal exits 4 with no answer; with a model mismatch exits 4 naming both; mismatch alone exits 2
A refusal fails the build even when the turn ends SUCCESS with an answer
Build result emitted only on success; failure result has answer null and no build
actions trace is bounded to 64 and keeps a refusal across later updates
